name: Ground-Based Photon
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 15. One of the ground base fits — the chassis is the
GBD1's and is identical across all of them: one shield of 12 (P2.73), two hull boxes, a bridge,
sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0, five crew, two boarding parties, minCrew 2, DK:4, EX:0,
CR:0. Only the weapons, the power plant, the BPV and the year differ.
AWR, NOT APR — the only fit that differs. A photon arms from warp power, so this base
carries an auxiliary warp reactor where the others carry an auxiliary power reactor.
Read off the sheet rather than inherited, and it is the kind of thing copying the
chassis would have silently got wrong.
